userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this session.

date.description: The date of the session in YYYY-MM-DD format.

started_at.description: The start time of the session in ISO 8601 format.

ended_at.description: The end time of the session in ISO 8601 format.

planned_minutes.description: The planned duration of the session in minutes.

task.description: The task the user worked on.

reflection.description: A short reflection on the session.

rank.description: The self-evaluated rank of the session.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores the pomodoro sessions for a specific user.
